profile.name: Maya Lindqvist
profile.summary: Product manager with four years in scheduling and payments software. I work closely with design and engineering, talk to customers every week, and like features that are small enough to ship in a month and measure in the next one.

descriptions: Own scheduling and shift swaps for about 3,000 hourly teams
Cut unfilled shifts by 18% by adding swap requests and reminders after interviewing 40 store managers about why shifts went empty
Run quarterly planning with two engineering teams and a designer
Wrote the team's first product metrics guide, so every launch now ships with a named success measure and a review date
Launched saved cards for repeat customers; checkout time fell by a third
Ran 25 A/B tests on the payment page and kept a public log of every result
Handled the product side of a card network change on a fixed deadline
Built weekly order reports in SQL and Excel for 12 warehouse managers
Wrote requirements for a new returns process that reduced manual data entry
